*/Id.label: Identifier
*/Id.description: The unique identifier of the convention. A curve segment, a quote or another convention refers to the convention by it.
*/Id.reason: The guide describes Id once, in the introduction to the chapter, and lists it in no section. The second sentence is ours: curve segments and the other conventions name a convention by its Id.

*/LongIndex.label: Long leg index
*/LongIndex.description: The name of the Ibor or overnight index the long leg references, in the long and short form of a tenor basis swap.
*/LongIndex.reason: The ORE guide documents the paying and receiving form of a tenor basis swap and not the long and short form. The text is authored from the field the ORE parser reads, which states what the value is and nothing more.
